description: The companies and organizations whose lobbying reports name a specific bill in Congress, and the lobbying firms each one uses on it, with the bill's title, sponsor and latest action. Accepts a bill number (e.g. "H.R. 1", "S. 1582", "HR 4366") or words from its title (e.g. "GENIUS Act", "farm bill").

bill.description: Bill number or title words, e.g. "H.R. 3633" or "CLARITY Act".

congress.description: Congress number, e.g. 119 for 2025 and 2026. Default the current Congress.

name: who_lobbies_on_bill
title: Who lobbies on a bill
